image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Blenheim spaniel lying on a brown textured carpet. The dog is positioned horizontally across the frame, with its head on the left and body extending to the right. The coat features distinct chestnut-red patches on a white background. The ears are long and heavily feathered. The lighting is soft, likely indoor ambient light.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog's head is resting on the floor/carpet, obscuring the profile view required to verify the dome, stop, and nose angle. Only the side of the face and eye are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: One eye is clearly visible. It appears large, dark, and round, consistent with the breed standard. While 'wide apart' is hard to judge from a side angle, the visible eye matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ear is prominently displayed, showing significant length, low set position relative to the skull, and heavy, silky feathering/fringe.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat pattern is classic Blenheim: clear white base with distinct, rich chestnut/red patches. The boundaries between colors are sharp and natural.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture of the fur appears silky and straight rather than curly or wiry. Feathering is visible on the ears and along the body/legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Although the dog is lying down, the visible torso section suggests a compact build typical of toy spaniels, without excessive elongation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The legs are mostly tucked under the body or obscured by the angle and the carpet. Fine bone structure cannot be verified in this pose.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame; the image cuts off before the rear of the dog.
The subject is stationary (lying down), making gait assessment impossible.

To verify anatomical correctness of the visible limbs and head structure, ensuring no fusion or extra parts despite the lying pose.

Anatomical plausibility of the neck-shoulder connection
